english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when priority means the ranking or order in which things should be dealt with.

examples.english: We need to follow the priority order instead of rushing in and doing things randomly.
examples.traditional: 做嘢要跟住優先次序，唔好一嚟就亂咁做。
